scope: Ordinary taxable income of a full-year Australian resident aged 18 or over; before offsets and all levies. Not a pay or take-home estimate.
source_title: Income Tax Rates Act 1986, compilation 66, Schedule 7 Part I
verified_by: Codex official-source check; human review pending
notes: No LITO, WATO, Medicare levy/surcharge, HELP, deductions, foreign residents, working holiday makers, minors, part-year residency or special income components. No public calculator route is released from this foundation.
